name: Slide Design Prompts
summary: 128 presentation design-system prompt themes with palettes, fonts and slide previews, for ChatGPT or Claude.
description: Free prompts that each carry a complete slide design system: a hex-pinned color palette, named Google Fonts, a layout grammar and an avoid-list. Themes are grouped by use case (pitch deck, business, consulting, marketing, tech, creative, education, events, finance) and visual style (minimal, bold, elegant, playful, corporate, calm, warm, dark, tech, retro). Copy a theme's PROMPT.md into ChatGPT or Claude, or use the same themes in SlideSpeak's deck generator for PowerPoint and Google Slides.
contains: 128 themes across 9 use-case categories and 10 visual styles
each theme ships README.md, PROMPT.md and .webp slide previews
palettes pinned to hex values with named Google Fonts
